I have farmed this small plot of less than half an acre since my father gave it to me, and I grow maize mixed with beans here every year. This season I will put one bag of the government fertilizer into the planting holes because last year the cobs were much fatter where I did that, and I will also spread two baskets of goat manure before the rains come since the land is mine and I want to keep it strong. I plant my own saved red maize seed, the kind my family has always kept, and I do not buy chemicals or hire workers because I have no extra cash for that. My wife and I will do all the work ourselves, about twenty days from planting until we finish shelling and storing the harvest.
